messages:
Priya (partnerships): Quick heads-up — we're lining up LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter certification for the marketplace + ISV bundle. Need a short sync on data-model compatibility and gateway contract requirements before we hand to eng. Who's available today?
Ben (devex): I'm in. main risk is schema mismatches across adapters (embedding metadata + provenance fields). We can add a compatibility shim but need a concrete minimal contract.
Sam (eng-infra): Agreed. From gateway side we need token passthrough, request_metadata headers, and a stable retry/circuit policy.
Clara (platform): Also need listing artifacts: sample connector, privacy checklist, and e2e smoke test matrix for the marketplace page. Deadline for marketplace assets is EOD Friday.
Geoff (product): For announcement planning, marketing wants a target week two weeks out after certification. Can we lock the contract by next Wed?
Priya (partnerships): Next Wed works if engineering has the contract doc by Monday. Ben can you sketch the minimal contract?
Ben (devex): Sure — propose a tiny JSON contract:```json
{"vector": {"embedding": "float[]", "id": "string", "meta": {"source": "string", "timestamp": "ISO8601"}}, "query": {"text": "string", "context_ids": ["string"]}}
```Use this as the baseline for adapters. We can version it (v1) and run a quick validator in CI.
Sam (eng-infra): Gateway header names: `X-RW-Client`, `X-RW-Request-ID`, `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; passthrough means we forward `Authorization` to the backend connector when customer opts in. Also recommend `Retry-After` semantics on 429s.
Clara (platform): Nice. For marketplace listing we also need a short README and a small local demo (single-node) + instructions for SI partners to spin up in their infra. Can devex produce that? @Ben
Ben (devex): Yep, I can produce a 5-min demo and README. We'll include an adapter example for both LangChain and LlamaIndex usage snippets.
Geoff (product): For SI partners, training + runbook content needs to be ready by announcement. Suggest a partner kickoff call the day after launch.
Priya (partnerships): Good. What about hardware/dedicated flows? We should note any model quantization caveats for on-prem customers.
Sam (eng-infra): For Dedicated/on-prem we need a model profile doc: recommended quantization (int8/4), expected latency delta, and fallback policy to hosted models. I'll draft model-profile.md and include perf numbers.
Ben (devex): Small note: LlamaIndex connector uses `node-id` in metadata; LangChain examples use `source_id`. We'll map both to `meta.source` in the shim.
Clara (platform): Timeline recap: contract v1 by Mon, eng smoke tests by Wed, marketplace assets by Fri, announcement target two weeks after cert. Ops — who owns the CI validator?
Sam (eng-infra): I'll own CI validator and the gateway tests. Put a small GH issue and tag eng-infra.
Priya (partnerships): I'll coordinate partner comms and confirm SI training slot. Can everyone drop one blocker if they have it by EOD?
Ben (devex): Blocker: sample dataset for the demo (need privacy-cleared sample).
Sam (eng-infra): Blocker: test infra capacity for demo runs in us-west-2 — will validate today.
Clara (platform): Blocker: legal signoff for joint announcement copy — chasing legal.
Geoff (product): Blocker: marketing assets (1 pager + screenshots) — marketing to deliver early next week.
Priya (partnerships): Great. I'll follow up with a short checklist and a 30-min sync tomorrow. Thanks all :+1:
sprintbot: Reminder set for 1972580000 — "ISV adapter certification: checkpoint"
Priya (partnerships): ping me if anything slips, we'll move the announcement window accordingly.
